source_scope: Round 54 sequential review of printed Chapters 952–961 using Bqquge. Cumulative item ledger is EVENT-SOURCE-ITEMS-v5.4.csv. Catalog baseline remains v4.6 with append-only v4.7–v5.4 addenda; fixed schedule unchanged.

confirmed_outcomes.event: Route loot includes one frozen Gold chest, one frozen Silver chest, Orange Deep Sea Pearls x3, a damaged giant ship, and an Orange fish.
Ritual-site receipts include Divinity Crystals x50, God Heart, Ancient Spirit Remains, Eye of Seven Sins, and Resentment Crystal.
The crew reaches the Polar Ogre fortress; no receipt list here.
Battle begins; no quantified loot list.
Ogre fortress is defeated. Loot is collected, but battle drops remain broadly described. A vault key is mentioned later.
Ogre vault yields large quantities of metals, hides and gems, relics, 4,716 Divine Power Fragments, and a demigod Frost Cannon blueprint; two legendary armors and a key are retrieved.
A demigod Blood Whale is decomposed; printed material quantities are recorded in the ledger. The vault's 4,716 shards are the prior chapter's receipt, not a new one.
The Fortune Dice roll grants Luck +50% and four attributes +20% for 24 hours; Eternal Power makes the state permanent. This is a status reward, not an item.

Ancient coins are exchanged for 26 Gold, four Moon, and one Redcloud ancient chests. 401 frozen chests are opened; only named, quantified examples are entered. Ancient Gold and Moon chest outputs are also listed.
The Ancient Redcloud Chest yields Mechanical Heart (semi-artifact), Combat Drones x15, and Magnetic Bombs x8; two armor item panels confirm prior Ch957 finds.
